title: CPF Module Schema: Azure Web Static App
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-staticwebapp'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

app_settings.description: (Optional) A map of app settings to be applied to the static site.

basic_auth.description: (Optional) A Identity block as defined below. password = "(Required) The password for the basic authentication access." environments = "(Required) The Environment types to use the Basic Auth for access."

configuration_file_changes_enabled.description: (Optional) Should changes to the configuration file be permitted.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

identity.description: (Optional) An identity block as defined below object({ type = "(Required) Specifies the type of Managed Service Identity that should be configured on this Static Web App. Possible values are `SystemAssigned`, `UserAssigned`, `SystemAssigned, UserAssigned` (to enable both)." identity_ids = "(Optional) Specifies a list of User Assigned Managed Identity IDs to be assigned to this App Configuration. This is required when `type` is set to `UserAssigned` or `SystemAssigned, UserAssigned`." })

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

name.description: (Optional) The name of the Azure Static Web App. If not provided, the name will be auto-generated using the resource naming module based on org_id, app_id, location, environment, context, and instance.

public_network_access_enabled.description: (Optional) Should public network access be enabled for the Static Web App.

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

sku_size.description: (Optional) The pricing size of the Azure Static Web App.

sku_tier.description: (Optional) The pricing tier of the Azure Static Web App.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

id.description: The ID of the Static Web App.

name.description: The Name of the Static Web App.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Staticwebapp' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
